cells.gaps: No source says registration gives a firm one number shared with the tax authority or social security; the board was working in November 2026 to bring the National Identification Number into registration. Beneficial owners are not recorded in any source.
cells.note: President Bio launched the National Investment Board's Online Business Registration System on 10 November 2026, letting applicants register and obtain certificates online (SLE-005, SLE-006), so registration is in service: stage 3. Stage 4 needs a number shared with tax or social security, and none is found.
